title: `get_velocity_at_local_position()` in `GodotPhysicsDirectBodyState2D` ignores custom `center_of_mass`
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduced in `4.8.dev`, `4.7.stable`.

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev1 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9636) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700H (20 threads) - 15.69 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

`GodotPhysicsDirectBodyState2D::get_velocity_at_local_position()` ignores custom `center_of_mass`, thus returning an incorrect result.

Square A (left) is correct, since the center of mass is at the body's origin.

Square B (right) should have (0, 0) velocity at the pink point, since the center of mass is offset from the body's origin, and the pink point is at the center of mass/ point of rotation.

Its 3D counterpart does not have this issue and returns a correct result.

I can open a PR if needed.

Video:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/86560703-6dfe-402b-a784-97b8dd2eb4a2

Relevant 2D code:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c939bf3791ce40ff70e0ee29f06486da1ebb6a84/modules/godot_physics_2d/godot_body_direct_state_2d.cpp#L90-L92
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c939bf3791ce40ff70e0ee29f06486da1ebb6a84/modules/godot_physics_2d/godot_body_2d.h#L323-L325
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c939bf3791ce40ff70e0ee29f06486da1ebb6a84/doc/classes/PhysicsDirectBodyState2D.xml#L195-L202

Relevant 3D code:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c939bf3791ce40ff70e0ee29f06486da1ebb6a84/modules/godot_physics_3d/godot_body_direct_state_3d.cpp#L98-L100
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c939bf3791ce40ff70e0ee29f06486da1ebb6a84/modules/godot_physics_3d/godot_body_3d.h#L323-L325
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c939bf3791ce40ff70e0ee29f06486da1ebb6a84/doc/classes/PhysicsDirectBodyState3D.xml#L195-L202

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the MRP and run `main_2d`.
2. Notice that square A (left) and square B (right) have different `center_of_mass`, but `get_velocity_at_local_position()` returns the same results for both.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRP_2D_get_velocity_at_local_position.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29797069/MRP_2D_get_velocity_at_local_position.zip)
